title: Gratitude During a Difficult Diagnosis
paragraphs: When Farouk received a difficult medical diagnosis, his first instinct was to ask why this was happening to him specifically, cycling through frustration and quiet fear over the following days.
A close friend, who had faced a similar diagnosis years earlier, encouraged him to focus on what remained rather than what had changed, reminding him gently that Allah tests those He cares for.
This perspective did not remove Farouk's fear entirely, but it gave him something steady to hold onto during his treatment, rather than facing each difficult day with only anxiety.
Months later, in recovery, Farouk admitted that his illness had deepened his gratitude for ordinary days in a way that comfort alone had never managed to teach him before.
